outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured confocal micrograph images (time-lapse photoactivation frames), not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B shows line/scatter plots of normalized intensity over time (raw measurement points with fitted diffusion model curves) and insets of averaged early time-point responses plotted as a time series with error bars. These are line-type plots, which are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points since doing so would make the dense time-series unreadable; the main plots already display the underlying raw data points rather than a single bar/mean summary.
